steps.text: A low harmonic resonance vibrates through the metal floor plates, rising from the deep oceanic current below.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: Do you feel that? The pressure... it's changing.
The air grows heavy, carrying the distant echo of a song long forgotten.
The squad retreats to regroup after the defeat.
Patch up, recharge shields, and consider buffing allies before re-engaging. Status items and defensive skills can swing the next encounter.
A security lock halts your progress.
Check your objectives or inventory—certain rooms need power restored or a keycard before they open.
Sensors flag movement beyond the doorway.
Clear nearby threats or prepare a pre-emptive strike—some exits stay sealed until the ambush is dealt with.

steps.speaker: Ollie
steps.text: Nova! There you are! We're late to meet Jed.

steps.speaker: Ollie
steps.text: Touch my name on your HUD, choose Talk, and let's catch up to him before he locks up.
The generator catches. Work lights snap on down the tunnel, one row after another. Nova keeps her palm on the switch until it stops shaking.
Heavy locks release farther down the mine. Under the returning machinery, the strange hum is still there.
Ellie carefully packs the shattered display into a crate for repair.
Maddie hands over the grinder, hopeful you can repair it.
Kasey reluctantly passes you the cracked projector lens.
All three broken units are back on Jed's bench.
Colony camera feeds cycle through wide, close, and tracking angles for visual calibration.
The view locks, drifts, then settles as the scene framing comes online.
Status captions pulse across the feed, translating colony alarms into something readable.
The caption layer holds long enough to read before the next warning takes its place.
Narration settles over the scene like a system log with a pulse.
Emergency color grading washes the image in warning reds and cold industrial blues.
The scene fades down until only the colony hum remains.
A white impact flare swallows the frame, then snaps back to the room.
A fractured memory cuts through the present, bright at the edges and gone too fast.
The frame narrows, focusing attention on the single choice left in front of Nova.
Trade Row opens into noise, heat, and a dozen quiet deals pretending to be legal.
Every visual layer stacks together: motion, captions, filters, and the pressure of the moment.
The narrator catches the quiet detail the alarms are too loud to notice.
The camera glides across the room, letting the damage tell the story first.
Dust, sparks, and tiny motes of resonance drift through the light.
A ring of pressure ripples outward, bending the air into visible sound.
Jed taps the bench twice. Nova reaches for the power switch before he can remind her. He shifts the housing closer, leaving her room to work.
The cutter settles to a steady idle. Jed checks the gauge twice. Nova catches him doing it; he gives her the small nod she was waiting for.
The shattered display slides onto Jed's bench, another broken thing waiting for stubborn hands.
The grinder lands with a heavy clunk, smelling of dust, old grease, and useful trouble.
The cracked projector lens catches the work light, splitting it into tired little rainbows.
The frame jolts as something heavy hits nearby.
Motion streaks tear past the viewport as the launch rail takes hold.
The horizon tips sideways, making the corridor feel even less trustworthy.
The open square catches every sound at once: boots, vendors, distant machinery, and the low electric buzz of surveillance.
The visual effects layer blooms across the frame, then folds back into the scene.
The edges darken, pulling the eye toward the one detail that matters.
A hard transition sweeps the old room away and leaves the next danger waiting.
The view tightens slowly, closing the distance before anyone moves.
The camera pushes forward and tracks sideways, following the line of trouble through the room.
Phase sweep: 87 kHz. Cold loop: 68%. Ground phase: 180 degrees. The three diagnostic bands settle together. For a breath, Nova feels the cutter stop fighting her.
The damaged cradle closes its circuit through cutter, suit, and operator. The grip turns hot. Nova tries to pull away; her fingers won't open.
The Cryo-Inductor fuses with a sharp pop. The Flux Liner carries the discharge into the floor, burning its sacrificial ground strip open. Nova's knees strike the stone.
Pain rings through her teeth and left hand. Her suit clock skips half a second. Beneath the fading hum, another pulse keeps time with her breathing.
Nova lets the cutter fall. Her hand won't stop trembling. The Fork lifts free of its cradle. Above the mine, a Harmony sensor registers the Architect handshake and turns red.
The pod's capacitors kick it off the rail. Nova catches one last glimpse of the colony. Beside her, the Chime opens the launch interlock, then locks navigation onto its paired beacon.
Zeke pulls at the route controls. The display snaps back to the same heading. Ahead, the permitted corridor slides out of reach and the planetary shield fills the viewport.
The shield rejects the pod. White light floods the cabin; the impact tears a stabilizer loose and throws them back toward Sector 9.

steps.speaker: Zeke
steps.text: It won't let me turn! Nova, I can't get us clear!
Look at me. Hook your arm through the frame. I'm here.
steps.speaker: Nova

steps.text: The navigation console arcs and goes dark. Zeke grips the frame beside Nova as the pod rolls into the storm. Rain hammers the hull. The thrusters sputter out.
Black branches rush across the viewport. The pod tears through the canopy and hits hard. Nova's hand is still reaching for Zeke when the lights go out.
Nova seats the cracked circuit board in the isolated socket. Encrypted commands crowd the screen. She checks the disconnected network cable before touching the keys.
A hidden block opens: overlapping wave patterns, repeated like a signature. Below them is one name: Chorus. Nova reads it twice.
ACCESS KEY WRITTEN TO REMOVABLE BOARD. NETWORK TRANSMISSION: NONE. Nova pulls the board. The recovered key clears from the terminal, leaving nothing on the network to follow her.
The discarded datapad warms in Nova's hand. Its battery warning covers half a final shift log. She lowers the brightness to keep it alive.
'They sealed the doors from outside. Called the collapse a biohazard. We only broke into a pocket of hum. We've been knocking between shifts of the drills. Nobody's answered.'
'The sound comes in waves. We count them so we don't lose track of the hours. If somebody gets this out, tell them we were still here. We didn't abandon the shift.'
The screen goes dark. Nova waits, then presses the power key once more. Nothing. She puts the datapad away instead of leaving it with the empty helmets.
SECTOR 9 // TWENTY YEARS EARLIER

steps.speaker: Lab PA
steps.text: SOURCE BEAST CONTAINMENT BREACH. FAR DOOR PRESSURE RISING.
The inner doors buckle. An operator locks the brass Chime into the tube.
Broadcast my identity. Get it away from them.
The tube fires, rocketing through the conduit.
A chord answers through the dark. The receiver needles rise together.
Mute the room. Seal me in.
The pod seals. The beacon continues in the dark.
STARBORN
Nova clamps the Flux Liner's ground strip to the floor bus. Cold loop: 68%. She opens the governor bypass. Jed keeps one hand beside the cut-off.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: One sweep. I'm watching the heat.
The cutter fires. Its phase sweep catches the buried conduit under Jed's bench. The breaker slams open. Dust falls into Nova's hair; the hum keeps climbing.

steps.speaker: Jed
steps.text: Kill it, Nova!

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: I have. Jed... it's still answering.
A terminal stamps CUTTER FAULT 4C-117 beside NOVA VANCE. Jed reaches past the report to steady her hand. Far below the workshop, an old chamber seal cracks.
Nova opens the Bridge alone. Heat climbs her arm and her knees buckle.

steps.speaker: Orion
steps.text: Close it. The Bridge connects; it does not make one body carry the circuit.
Zeke clips a ground lead to Nova's bracer. Gh0st checks the empty command channel, then offers his armored hand.

steps.speaker: Gh0st
steps.text: No command attached. Proceed.
Orion holds the counter-tone. The current divides across four willing contacts, and Zeke's wound steadies.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: Link. Not merge. I get it.
The Ascended falls, but Vale's forced network remains active. Five protocol signatures align through the crew's practiced circuit and complete the Key's access pattern.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: Ground lead failed. Zeke, manual bus. Gh0st, brace left. Orion, hold the counter-tone.
The interface rejects Zeke, so he holds the bare ground path by hand. Gh0st takes the force aimed at the crew. Orion keeps the counter-tone level.

steps.speaker: Orion
steps.text: The Key is open. Release root access when the corridor clears.
Nova opens a regional corridor, drops Vale's forced links, and releases root access. Her Source connection burns out as the network closes.
They fall together.
Morning in the Colony. One regional corridor stands open. Vale and Harmony are gone here; Dominion traffic still moves beyond the sector.
At Zeke's diner, Nova remembers Tideglass sand in her boots and Zeke complaining about salt in the filters. Her tuning hand trembles against the photograph.

steps.speaker: Zeke
steps.text: For record accuracy: I complained about corrosion. The humidity was an associated grievance.

steps.speaker: Gh0st
steps.text: You also threw a canteen at me. Accuracy: 94%.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: The Source is gone. The thin whine stayed. I remember the rest.

steps.speaker: Orion
steps.text: Good. Now you can hear the wind.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: Sounds like a good day. Fill me in on the rest?

steps.speaker: Zeke
steps.text: Pull up a chair. It is a long story.
STAR BORN
Created by the Starborn team. Thank you for playing.
The Astra rises from the cradle. Jungle and tideglass fall away below; the Planetary Shield remains a distant ceiling.

steps.speaker: Orion
steps.text: Keep below the hard deck. This service airlane takes us to the Spire; we are not crossing the outer shield.
Dominion interference floods the local guidance bands. Gh0st braces the crew while Zeke holds the manual ground path.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: We have the city beneath us. Bring her down where the sensors cannot follow.
The Astra hits hard beneath the Spire. The crew survives, but the airlane is gone behind them.
